source: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
scope: Read-only review of CAT-01/CAT-02 closure and cleanup restart; no implementation or test execution.

closed.conclusion: One case owns one target Start. Cross-lesson concurrency uses different cases; same-case requests serialize. Proven terminal failure requires a new fixture for explicit retry; unresolved pending_unknown is not retry permission. Catalog dispositions now match the operation scope.

Stable lifecycle lock lives outside the removable directory. Supervisor-only cleanup resume handles partial or complete directory removal without opening SQLite/sidecar/key. Missing members are treated as removed; integrity/removal/sync failures retain quarantine; parent sync precedes durable deleted tombstone.

necessary_implementation_constraints: Cleanup resume inherits the case-lock then catalog-recheck ordering in section 56; do not rely on a pre-lock state snapshot.
Keep the stable lock identity across cleanup and restart; deleting/recreating a lock object while contenders exist would split exclusion.
Even if the case directory is already absent, sync the parent before appending deleted, as required by the section 109.4 oracle.
A catalog append failure after deletion retains unresolved/quarantined authorization, never reconstructs the case or retries Start.
Cross-case harness concurrency does not replace independent store tests for multiple lesson lifecycles in one database.

nonblocking_notes.detail: The requested valid canonical payload of exactly 256 bytes and valid catalog of exactly 16 MiB are not reachable with the current fixed four-field schema, fixed-length case ID, finite state enum and 65536 contiguous generations. Separate raw framing limit tests from valid semantic journal vectors; do not add padding or weaken canonical validation to manufacture these cases.
nonblocking_notes.impact: Acceptance-vector clarification before implementing those boundary tests; not a lifecycle or cleanup design blocker.

limitations: Design approval only; no catalog/supervisor implementation, OS lock/ACL validation, fault injection or crash recovery was executed.
The trusted supervisor account threat boundary remains unchanged; CRC is not authentication.
No production classroom, real model, audio or teaching completion claim.
